title: India Launches First Hydrogen Train, A New Era for Sustainable Transportation
summary: The Indian government has launched its first hydrogen train in the state of Haryana, marking a significant milestone in the country's transition to sustainable transportation. The train is part of the 'Namaste Green' initiative, aimed at reducing carbon emissions and promoting eco-friendly practices. The launch comes ahead of the country's commitment to reduce greenhouse gas emissions by 33-35% by 2030.
summary_points: India has launched its first hydrogen train in Haryana, a step towards sustainable transportation.
The train is part of the 'Namaste Green' initiative aimed at reducing carbon emissions.
The launch marks a significant milestone in India's transition to eco-friendly practices.
The country aims to reduce greenhouse gas emissions by 33-35% by 2030.
Hydrogen trains are seen as a promising alternative to traditional fossil fuel-based transportation.
